Hi, my name is Audrey and I am from Vancouver, BC. I completed a BSc in Computer Science with a minor in Data Science at UBC, where I developed a strong interest in AI/ML systems evaluation and large-scale data workflows. This interest ultimately led me to pursue the Master of Data Science program. This website documents my experiences, learning journey, and personal growth throughout the MDS program.
